decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting builds on the firm's established expertise in robust specialist lighting, and its own R&D and testing facilities let it interpret results and refine the line, so it stays visible and is likely kept.
General interior luminaires are the core of the firm's knowledge base in office and education lighting, so a second-generation line is easy to assimilate and improve.
The microprismatic pendant is a flagship that extends the firm's core optics and LED know-how and is still promoted as a latest release, which makes retention highly likely.
The marine searchlight fits the firm's specialist robust-lighting competence and has stayed on the website, although dropping the sister HMI searchlight suggests some portfolio pruning in this niche.
